newsitem.title: INDIA: India's RBI revises yen, DM deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: India's RBI revises yen, DM deposit rates.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Saturday it revised interest rates on foreign currency deposits denominated in Deutsche mark (DM) and Japanese yen.

Effective September 9, 1996, deposits in Japanese yen with a maturity of one year and above but less than two years would receive an interest of 1.25 percent per annum, against the existing one percent, the RBI said.

The interest on DM deposits with the same maturity would be four percent against 3.75 percent and for deposits with a maturity of two years and above but less than three years, it would be 4.75 percent against 4.50 percent, the RBI said.
